name: Power BI
purpose: Power BI solves the problem of transforming raw, disparate data into meaningful, interactive insights. It empowers users, from business users to data professionals, to connect, visualize, and share data across an organization, fostering data-driven decision-making.
keyCapabilities: Connect to diverse data sources and integrate them
Transform and model data for analysis using Power Query and DAX
Create interactive reports and dashboards with rich visualizations
Share and collaborate on insights securely across the organization
Leverage AI-powered features for advanced analytics and insights
integrations: SQL Server and Azure SQL Database
useCases: Financial reporting and forecasting to track cash flow, balance sheets, and profit-and-loss data
Sales and revenue analytics for monitoring performance, conversion rates, and opportunities
Operational efficiency improvements, such as inventory optimization and resource management
